name: text-handwrite-mask
title: Handwriting Write-on
description: Chữ hiện ra như đang được viết tay từng chữ một theo thứ tự, mỗi chữ mất thời gian theo độ dài nét, có đầu bút chạy theo.

moworks.author: takayu

options.total: s of writing, split by letter width (2.2)

credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-handwriting, written here): Write time 2.2 s from 0.3 s, split across glyphs by glyph width (≈ stroke length), one after another. Each glyph is revealed by a thick zig-zag stroke (segments 0.17 em apart, top ↔ bottom with ±0.07 em slant, width 1.7 × segment + 1 px, round caps) drawn with sine.inOut, used as a mask over the filled font. Under it a 55 % mute copy and a baseline; a pen (short line + accent dot) rides the stroke head. Fade out 3.6–4.0 s. Loop 4.2 s. Params: tổng thời gian (2.2 s) · độ dày nét quét (1.7 × bước) · đầu bút (bật / tắt). Each letter is revealed by a thick zig-zag stroke drawn as a mask (sine.inOut), with a pen riding its head.
moworks.titleVi: Chữ tự viết ra từng nét
